root_cause: Cross-warp read-before-clear race in _ordered_apply output buffer. Triton assigns different layouts to load and zero store.

within_first_512_words_of_tile.example: Warp 0 can clear word 128 before warp 1 loads it.

fix: Block barrier after consuming each group output and before clearing it.

principles.Fix Root Causes: The standalone queued reproducer isolates load/clear ordering before changing the prototype.
principles.Prove It Works: Timing stays gated on isolated raw-bit records and full per-word verification.
principles.Model the Domain: The recorder separates recurrent S raw-bit deltas from full dynamic tensor byte snapshots.
